correctness.rationale: Exact restriction of Wolfram Rule 28 to five no-11 neighborhoods yields output ones only from source neighborhoods 010 and 100. The identity x_i=y_i(1-y_{i-1}) is established for every source. Conversely, avoiding 111 and 0100 forces reconstruction to output y at all sites, including cyclic small-ring wraparound. The inverse generates no adjacent input ones. Transfer adjacency trace gives Lucas n and zeta; first-offender examples are explicit. The embedded independent full-truth-table verifier passed all n=1..15 and local five-bit contexts. Infinite assertion rests on the local proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The object is not an arbitrary small parameter slice: it is the canonical hard-core/golden-mean restriction of the standard nonregular Rule 28 cellular automaton. The result gives a complete structural all-period output shift, two minimal forbidden factors, and an exact radius-one memory decoder, proving lossless behavior and shift conjugacy despite nonregular unrestricted behavior. This clarifies a concrete change of invertibility induced by a natural input constraint; Lucas counting is ancillary and credited as classical. It does not claim full-shift invertibility or a new source-count formula.
